correctness.rationale: The original theorem and census are correct. Ordered neighbourhood assignments determine complete types by homogeneity and are realizable by the finite extension property; the adjacency channel is precisely disjoint pairs. An original replay (`python3 /workspace/independent_replay.py graph`) starts from triangle-free augmented graphs and deletes each possible marked edge. It counts extensions by three and four membership labels instead of the frozen subset-zeta procedure. For orders 1–5 it yields (decrease,tie,increase) = (0,0,0),(0,0,1),(0,0,9),(0,0,96),(80,0,1330), with two groups of 20 and 60. For the repaired connected-only result I also checked exhaustion structurally: the admissible endpoints have distance at least three, and the connected trees and possible 4- or 5-cycles give precisely the five rows in the repaired table. All five odds increase by exact cross multiplication. On six vertices insertion 03 into the given tree creates a 4-cycle, not a triangle. The hub/midpoint count and independently enumerated diagrams give 249 adjacent and 529 nonadjacent types before, 225 adjacent and 484 nonadjacent after, with exact drop 1491/551602. There is no claimed six-vertex census.
